Dated this the 4th day of June, 2024 This Criminal Miscellaneous Case has been filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, to quash Annexure A-FIR and Annexure C-Final Report and all other further proceedings thereto in C.C.84/2021 of the files of the Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Kollam.
The petitioners herein are accused Nos.1 to 3 in the above case.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor.

3. Though it is argued by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the ingredients to attract the offence punishable under Section 498A read with Section 34 of IPC are not made out in the materials, form part of the final report, as pointed out by the learned Public Prosecutor, as per Annexure B complaint, the specific overt acts of cruelty CRL.MC NO. 4754 OF 2024 demanding more dowry has been stated in paragraph Nos. 6 and 7 of the complaint.
Thus it appears that there are sufficient materials to go for trial.
Therefore, this is not a fit case for quashment.

Sd/-
